data.name: Cruel Trick
data.description: A bloody jake can maim or humiliate his target with a sneak attack, substituting 1 point of Dexterity or Charisma damage per die of sneak attack damage forfeited. A successful Will save negates this ability damage (DC %1).|10+SlayerLVL/2+CHA
